acornreply.name: AcornReply
acornreply.about: AcornReply is an AI support inbox for small teams: create tickets from your app and keep the knowledge base its AI drafts from in sync.

google-drive.name: Google Drive
google-drive.about: Google Drive is a secure cloud storage and file collaboration platform that lets users store, share, organize, sync, and collaborate on files from anywhere, inc

details.description: Runs when a new FAQ, article or past conversation is added to your knowledge base.
Make a file accessible via a shareable link and set access level (Viewer, Commenter, Editor).
Make a copy of a Google Drive file into a selected folder, optionally giving it a new name.
